//: The driver catalogs org.webosphoenix.hardware trusts (docs/DRIVERS.md). The Phoenix catalog's address, its pinned key and the report address are not here: they come from /etc/palm/phoenix/servers.json ("drivers": url, key, reportUrl; docs/PLATFORM-CLIENT.md), the device's one configuration of the platform's servers, written when the image is built. A driver catalog is never trusted on first use, as drivers install as root: without a key there the service lists the hardware and offers nothing (the owner makes the key with drivers.php keygen, docs/DRIVERS.md "Releasing the catalog", and the image is built with its public half). When the key moves, the old key signs a hand-over (key-handover.json) and devices follow it; a key in revoked is never trusted again, whatever signs it (a leaked key: a system update adds it here, with the new key).
